name: ego-browser
title_zh: 人机同席的浏览器，Agent 用你的登录态不抢方向盘
tagline_zh: 你刷网页时，Agent 在隔壁隔间替你填表、截图、抓数据——不抢焦点、不挤标签页，登录态直接复用。
tagline_en: While you browse, agents work in their own tab—filling forms, snapping screenshots, scraping data—reusing your.
desc_en: ego-browser (ego-lite) is a Chromium-based browser designed from the ground up to be friendly to both human users and AI Agents. AI Agents work in their own isolated space, reusing the user's login state without competing for the browser. Use this skill whenever the user needs to interact with a website opening pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting page data, testi
why_zh: 它把人类和 Agent 的会话物理隔离，但共享 Cookie 和存储。Agent 操作不打断你。
why_en: It physically separates human and agent sessions while sharing cookies and storage—so both work in parallel without stepping on.
limit_zh: 仅限 Chromium 内核，需本机安装 ego-lite 浏览器；不处理验证码、弹窗登录或需要真人确认的支付流程。
limit_en: Chromium-only; requires ego-lite installed locally. Won't handle CAPTCHAs, pop-up logins, or payments needing human confirmation. Agents can't touch.
title_en: A browser where AI agents share your login without.
